title: Lawn Mower Blade Sharpener for Drill – Double-Sided Grinding Stone
descriptionHtml:
Dull blade tearing up the grass?

A dull mower blade tears and drags at the grass instead of cutting it – the result is frayed blades of grass that turn yellow, and the motor has to work harder. Taking the blade in for sharpening costs both time and money.

A sharp blade in a few minutes

Put the grinding stone in your regular drill and sharpen the blade yourself in a couple of minutes. The double-sided design gives the right angle every time – for a clean cut, a nicer lawn and a longer life for the machine.

Features

  • Fits a regular drill – no special tools needed.
  • Double-sided grinding stone – the right angle every time.
  • Sharpens in minutes – skip the expensive drop-offs.
  • Compact and handheld – easy to store.
